description: Audit GitHub Actions workflows for the injection and supply-chain patterns behind real incidents: untrusted `${{ github.event.* }}` interpolated into `run:` or github-script (command/script injection), `pull_request_target` that checks out the fork's code with the repo's secrets ("pwn request"), actions pinned to a tag or branch instead of a commit SHA (tj-actions/changed-files, CVE-2025-30066, 23,000+ repos), `permissions: write-all`, hard-coded secrets, curl-pipe-to-shell and suspicious hosts. Each finding carries a rule id, severity, confidence (structural vs heuristic), file, line and job. Static analysis of the YAML you pass: nothing is fetched or run.

path.description: Path as it would sit in the repo; it decides how the file is read

name: actions_audit
